Name: Auto-Advance Dialogue
Author: n1truss
Description:
Auto-Advance Dialogue automatically moves through NPC dialogue once the speaker finishes speaking, so you never have to mash the button again. It pauses on any question or choice prompt so you never miss something important.

Fully configurable with Generic Mod Config Menu.

Born from wanting to fill my water bottle while listening to the Wizard.

Shouldn't have any incompatibilities, please post any issues.

Consider endorsement please :)
